findings.evidence: Vision emits needs_confirmation for confidence below 0.75 or ambiguity. The server-owned nutrition scan-context allowlist omits this state, while web enrichment eligibility primarily uses the 0.45 minimum recognition confidence, validation issues and generic-name rejection.
findings.risk: A specific but unresolved visual identity may spend provider quota and receive an automatically merged nutrition profile before the user confirms the food name.
findings.required_action: Carry server-owned identity confirmation state and confirmation revision in authority context. Reject unresolved items before any provider call; after user confirmation, create a new revision and rerun TFDA/USDA lookup.
findings.acceptance: Tests prove unresolved/generic/validation-flagged items cause zero Tavily Search, Extract and model calls; client-supplied confirmed flags cannot bypass the gate.

findings.evidence: The codebase contains a server-signed authority service, authenticated enrichment route, scanner conditional request/merge, and SQLite-backed request, quota, lease and cache paths with prior isolated validation.
findings.risk: The plan incorrectly describes these implemented paths as absent, which could cause duplicate work and obscure the actual missing live-source acceptance.
findings.required_action: Update current status to distinguish code wiring/isolation tests from unverified production flags and missing rights-cleared real Tavily positive acceptance.

findings.evidence: The bok-choy USDA FDC candidates include raw and cooked records; the intended photographed ingredient is cooked, and the user excludes added oil but did not request whole-dish nutrition.
findings.risk: Multiplying raw per-100-g values by estimated cooked grams would imply unsupported cooked-serving precision.
findings.required_action: Keep raw and prepared identities distinct. If only raw data exists, present only an explicitly labeled raw per-100-g reference without cooked portion calculation, or leave unmatched if UI cannot represent reference-only safely.

findings.evidence: FSANZ public terms do not support the supplied claim that acceptance only occurs at a checkbox or that attribution alone settles reuse. User direction is not to contact FSANZ; Tavily Help Center and Platform Terms scope remains to be documented for public enablement.
findings.required_action: Keep AFCD excluded without contacting FSANZ. Separate isolated technical testing, source-policy admission and production enablement; document Tavily and publisher rights before public use.

findings.evidence: 0.45 is the minimum recognition threshold and 0.75 is a confirmation heuristic; neither is supported by an independent calibration set. Existing photos/screenshots do not provide independent identity, weight or nutrition ground truth.
findings.required_action: Do not claim high confidence from model scores. Report identity accuracy, source compatibility, portion error, coverage and abstention separately against human-labeled and weighed data; treat 30 samples as exploratory only.

findings.evidence: The batch 83 screenshot summary says no nutrition data is matched while an item displays a USDA reference candidate awaiting confirmation.
findings.required_action: Before user-facing rollout, distinguish candidate found, awaiting confirmation, not included in totals, and no source found.

current_next_sequence: Persist server-owned needs_confirmation/identity status and confirmed revision; fail closed before provider calls and add zero-call tests.
For a specifically confirmed bok choy item, add a server-allowlisted English FDC query alias; preserve generic-name rejection and user candidate confirmation.
Validate raw/boiled/stir-fried compatibility and reference-only presentation; never calculate cooked portions from raw per-100-g data.
Select a true TFDA/USDA-compatible miss with documented Tavily applicability and publisher rights, then run isolated Tavily/model extraction acceptance.
Only after rights, live positive acceptance, runtime flags, cost/capacity, UI semantics and SQLite retention gates pass, consider production enablement.
limitations: This was document and static code review, not runtime or nutritional validation.
Private production feature flags were not inspected.
No legal opinion was provided and no source was admitted.
